ctaBlockTitle: Find these places in Seattle on your phone
seoTitle: Finding a toilet, a tap or a shower in Seattle
seoText: General map apps are built around businesses and directions, so the free and public things — a toilet in a park, a drinking fountain on a square, a shower at a beach — are the ones they cover least well. That is the gap this map fills. In Seattle it currently holds 219 public toilets and 198 places to refill a bottle, each with whatever the source records about cost, opening hours and access. It works the same way in every city you travel to next.
highlight: 728 of the 2,479 places mapped in Seattle are recorded as free of charge.
